calibration: UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine
labels: the sky light lights the beauty only; the backdrop sphere is in BeautyOnlyActors (every label capture hides it), unlit translucent, no depth, custom depth or velocity, no shadow

backdrop.placement: a sphere at radius_km (a photographed sky's cloud distance), so the height fog and aerial perspective veil it as they would those clouds; drawn over sky pixels only (opaque scene depth beyond sky_depth_cm)
backdrop.law: per frame (frames[].hdri_backdrop_opacity): full below full_below_agl_m of camera height over the card's ground (world Z), none above none_above_agl_m, smoothstep between (hdri_sky.backdrop_weight); hidden until the sky light's switch

switch_result.basis: intensity = intensity_before x (captured upward irradiance / the HDRI's, luminance, both the sky light's SH at +Z) x fill_gain; the lower hemisphere divided by the intensity change (baked into the cube before the intensity), and under an overcast or storm photograph capped at LowerCapAlbedo x the sky's upward irradiance / pi (no sun reaches that ground: hdri_sky.lower_hemisphere_cap); yaw puts the photograph's sun at the directional light's azimuth (hdri_sky.cubemap_yaw_deg)
